# Fixtures for `ios_backup_plist` (iOS backup Info.plist / Manifest.plist)

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour) with fixed times; names, devices, teams and addresses (`example.org`) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/apple.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `Info.plist` | plutil, in the layout iTunes / Finder backups use (fictitious device) | CC0-1.0 |
| `Manifest.plist` | plutil, binary | CC0-1.0 |
| `Status.plist` | plutil, binary | CC0-1.0 |
